# Analytic approximation of the 95% HDI width (mean_RT scale) for H1-H4.

```{r}
sigma    = 45.5   # pilot ExGaussian sigma
tau      = 93.2   # pilot tau (beta intercept)
n_trials = 37     # trials per cell per participant
sd_between = c(H1 = 24.3, H2 = 10.0, H3 = 9.3, H4 = 7.5)  # pilot by-participant slope SDs
target     = c(H1 = 30,   H2 = 20,   H3 = 10,  H4 = 10)

```

---

## Design matrix

```{r}
d = expand.grid(curr_cong  = c(-.5, .5),
                 prev_cong  = c(.5, -.5),
                 prev_color = c("loss", "gain", "neutral"))
d$c_loss = ifelse(d$prev_color == "loss",  2/3, -1/3)
d$c_gain = ifelse(d$prev_color == "gain",  2/3, -1/3)
X = model.matrix(~ curr_cong * prev_cong * c_loss + curr_cong * prev_cong * c_gain, d)

terms = c(H1 = "curr_cong", H2 = "curr_cong:prev_cong",
           H3 = "curr_cong:prev_cong:c_loss", H4 = "curr_cong:prev_cong:c_gain")
```

---

## Per-participant sampling variance of each coefficient

```{r}
within_var = setNames(
  ((sigma^2 + tau^2) / n_trials * diag(solve(crossprod(X))))[terms], names(terms))

k = 2 * qnorm(.975) * sqrt(within_var + sd_between^2) 
```

---

## Results

```{r}
width_at_N  = function(N) k / sqrt(N)
n_needed    = function(target) ceiling((k / target)^2)

round(width_at_N(40), 1)   # approx. widths at N = 40
n_needed(target)           
```
